resources.string: Connects Helper Application to Mes Validation for call recording. Enable this in Accessibility. Do not enable the accessibility shortcut.
Helper Application needs these permissions to be able do the following:
to allow the app to record calls
to detect incoming and outgoing calls
to detect whether a Bluetooth headset is active during a recording
Helper Application battery usage should not be optimized by your phone\'s built-in or third-party optimizer. Otherwise, you might not get the option to record calls.
Helper Application needs Mes Validation Connection enabled in Accessibility to detect calls and send them to the Mes Validation app for recording.
ATTENTION! Do NOT enable the shortcut option of the service. Unintentional touches on it can cause instability of the app.
Go to Accessibility > Installed / Downloaded apps > Call OS Helper > turn ON Mes Validation Connection (main switch, not the shortcut).
Status: Mes Validation Connection is ON
Status: Mes Validation Connection is still OFF
On Realme / Android 13+: first tap ALLOW RESTRICTED SETTINGS, open App info menu (⋮) > Allow restricted settings, then enable the service. Remove the floating shortcut if you added it.
Mes Validation (com.mesvalidation) is not installed. Install it to record calls.
Mode: Local recording (Mes Validation not installed)
Mode: Signals Mes Validation app to record
ACR-style (default): speakerphone + mic during calls — same as Cube ACR Helper Accessibility. Optional: Shizuku or MediaProjection below.
Status: ACR-style ON — speaker boost during calls (like Cube Helper)
Default — same as Cube ACR Helper without Shizuku: turns on speakerphone during calls so the microphone picks up both sides. Keep volume audible; use speaker or earpiece at normal level.

Not required for ACR-style recording. For advanced capture: install Shizuku from Play Store (moe.shizuku.privileged.api), start it via wireless debugging, then grant permission here. NLL Store Shizuku is optional (only if you use ACR Phone Helper with that fork).
Status: Shizuku connected (privileged recording service active)
Status: Shizuku not running — open app and start
Status: Start Shizuku, then return here to grant access
Status: Starting privileged recording process… (first wait up to 35s)
Status: Shizuku allowed but privileged recorder not running. After enabling in Shizuku: force-stop Call OS Helper → open again.
Status: Shizuku enabled in manager but binder missing — Force stop Helper, reopen app

Status: Privileged recorder did not start (%1$d/%2$d bind attempts timed out).

Shizuku access is OK. The shell subprocess (app_process :service) never connected — common on realme/ColorOS, MIUI, Samsung, Android 14–16.

Try: Settings → Apps → Shizuku + Call OS Helper → Battery → Unrestricted. In Shizuku tap Start, then tap RETRY below. Logcat: package moe.shizuku.privileged.api, search ShizukuServiceStarter.

Until privileged recorder works: enable Speaker boost (above) for audible one-sided capture.
Status: Shizuku access OK — auto-binding privileged recorder (up to 4 attempts)…

Records call playback + your mic (no loudspeaker). Tap Enable → Next → Start on the system screen. If the dialer opens, press Home and return here. Rebuild the app for a simpler “entire screen only” prompt. Keep Mes Validation Connection ON.

Two-way recording needs Android's "Share screen" permission (call audio only).

1. Tap Continue
2. Tap Next → Start (entire screen — do not pick apps)
3. If the Phone/dialer opens anyway, press Home and open Call OS Helper again
4. Check: "Two-way mode ON"

To avoid this flow, use Speaker boost instead.
If the dialer opened after you picked Phone, press Home → open Call OS Helper. If status is not ON, tap Enable again (new builds use entire screen only).
Status: Two-way mode OFF — mic-only fallback

Headset/earphone was connected during the call. Your voice is recorded from the mic; the other person\'s voice usually plays only in the headset, so it is missing. For two-way: unplug headset, enable speaker boost, and use loudspeaker (same as Cube ACR).
Only your voice was captured. On this Samsung build, two-way playback is blocked. Turn ON Speaker boost, unplug headset, use loudspeaker, and test again (AMR path).
Two-way is ON but Samsung blocked remote call audio in playback capture. Use Speaker boost + loudspeaker for both voices, or try Cube ACR on the same phone.
Recording — tap SPEAKER in Phone app (both voices)
Your voice was saved. For the other person: during the call open Phone app and tap Speaker (loudspeaker), volume high, no headset. Rebuild app uses MIC source when speaker boost is on.
Saved with audio. If you still hear only yourself, reinstall this update (uses VOICE_COMMUNICATION + speaker probe) and test with loudspeaker at high volume.
Folder not created yet. Tap “Create folder” or complete setup again.
There are no unsent records. Everything is OK.
Call OS Helper is ready. Calls are saved to Documents/MesValidationCallRecorder. On most phones only the microphone is allowed — use speakerphone if playback is silent.
Setup is complete. Open Mes Validation to use full recording, or continue using local recording in this app.

The legislation regarding phone call recording varies in different countries and states. Please make sure that you\'re not breaking the legislation of your or your callee/caller country. Always notify the callee/caller that your conversation will be recorded and ask for their permission.
